```{r}
display_saved_image <- function(path, pending_message) {
  if (file.exists(path)) {
    knitr::include_graphics(path)
  } else {
    knitr::asis_output(paste0("<p><em>", pending_message, "</em></p>\n"))
  }
}

decision_of <- function(id) {
  if (is.null(battery)) return("pending")
  battery[hypothesis_id == id, decision][1]
}
```

# 2DG and seqFISH Co-embedding in Allen CCF

## Overview

This notebook treats the WildR-versus-SPF Intruder 2DG map as a **group-level**
contrast co-embedded with seqFISH NEUROeSTIMator activity in Allen CCFv3. The
upgrade adds what a controlled analysis requires: Baseline and within-genotype
Intruder−Baseline maps warped through the same Template transforms as
specificity controls, a pre-specified H1–H5 hypothesis battery with explicit
pass/fail language, and an interactive 3D CCF viewer with optional anatomy and
seqFISH overlays.

```{r}
#| label: display-stats
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

n_accepted <- if (is.null(registration)) {
  0L
} else {
  sum(registration$accepted_final)
}
n_supported <- if (is.null(battery)) {
  0L
} else {
  sum(battery$decision == "supported")
}
n_tested <- if (is.null(battery)) 0L else nrow(battery)
cat("::: {.stat-row}\n")
cat("::: {.stat}\n[", n_accepted, "]{.stat-value}\n[Slices passing strict QC]{.stat-label}\n:::\n", sep = "")
cat("::: {.stat}\n[", n_tested, "]{.stat-value}\n[Pre-specified hypotheses]{.stat-label}\n:::\n", sep = "")
cat("::: {.stat}\n[", n_supported, "]{.stat-value}\n[Hypotheses supported]{.stat-label}\n:::\n", sep = "")
cat("::: {.stat}\n[3]{.stat-value}\n[Map families in CCF]{.stat-label}\n:::\n")
cat(":::\n")
```

## Background

Scalar `Template/` anatomy and `WildRvSPF Intruder/` t maps are the primary
inputs (`2DG = y/1.494`, `t = (y/18.409)−7.762`). Accepted Template→CCF warps
from [data/interim/2DG_CCF_Integration/2026-11-11]{.path} are reused—without
re-fitting Elastix—to place Baseline and WildR/SPF Intruder−Baseline RGB maps
into the same coordinates via the validated 254-color LUT. seqFISH still lacks
a verified section→animal key, so every cross-modality test remains
section/gate-level and non-animal.

## Hypotheses

These five claims were written before inspecting the control-map results. Only
they appear as findings.

| ID | Claim | Primary test | Control |
|----|-------|--------------|---------|
| H1 | Accepted Template slices occupy plausible CCF planes | Dice + AP continuity QC | Continuity gate retained |
| H2 | Positive Intruder \|t\| is enriched in a pre-specified limbic/hypothalamic annotation set | Set-vs-complement Δmean\|t\| + 10k label permutations | Same test on Baseline |
| H3 | Gate-allocated Intruder positive mean t correlates with NEUROeSTIMator Hedges' g | Spearman + gate permutation; α = 0.10 on this metric only | Baseline-allocated positive mean t |
| H4 | Intruder association is not explained by within-genotype Intruder−Baseline maps | \|ρ\|_Intruder vs max(\|ρ\|_WildR I−B, \|ρ\|_SPF I−B) with gate bootstrap | I−B maps |
| H5 | ROI seed footprints land in expected Allen parcels | Seed-slice IoU vs target parcels | Anatomical QC only |

## Results

### H1 — Registration QC is tight where accepted

::: {.figure-card .fig-wide}
```{r}
#| label: display-h1-registration
#| echo: false
#| out.width: "100%"

display_saved_image(
  registration_figure,
  "Controlled registration QC figure not yet written."
)
```

::: {.fig-caption}
[**Figure 1.**]{.fig-num} Template→CCF Dice by source slice. Green =
`accepted_final`; orange = high-Dice fits rejected only by AP continuity; grey =
failed or blank.
:::

::: {.takeaways}
**Decision: `r decision_of("H1")`**

- 53/66 slices pass strict QC; mean Dice among accepted = 0.960.
- 12 continuity rejects keep high Dice without inventing an AP trajectory.
- Template001 is blank and is skipped.
:::
:::

### H2 — Limbic/hypothalamic enrichment is Baseline-like, not Intruder-specific

::: {.figure-card}
```{r}
#| label: display-h2
#| echo: false
#| out.width: "100%"

display_saved_image(
  h2_figure,
  "H2 enrichment figure not yet written."
)
```

::: {.fig-caption}
[**Figure 3.**]{.fig-num} Pre-specified limbic/hypothalamic annotation set versus
complement: Δ mean \|t\| for Intruder and Baseline maps (10k label permutations).
:::

::: {.takeaways}
**Decision: `r decision_of("H2")`**

- Intruder Δmean\|t\| = −0.032 (p ≈ 0.85): no enrichment in the pre-specified set.
- Baseline Δmean\|t\| = +0.63 (p ≈ 0.0003): enrichment is Baseline-driven.
- Control requirement fails: Intruder is not stronger than Baseline.
:::
:::

### H3 — Intruder positive mean t tracks gated NEUROeSTIMator g; Baseline does not

::: {.figure-card .fig-wide}
```{r}
#| label: display-h3-triad
#| echo: false
#| out.width: "100%"

display_saved_image(
  triad_figure,
  "Control-triad figure not yet written."
)
```

::: {.fig-caption}
[**Figure 4.**]{.fig-num} Gate-allocated positive mean t versus NEUROeSTIMator
Hedges' g for Intruder, Baseline, WildR Intruder−Baseline, and SPF
Intruder−Baseline.
:::

::: {.takeaways}
**Decision: `r decision_of("H3")`**

- Intruder Spearman ρ = −0.661 across 10 gates (permutation p ≈ 0.041; pre-declared α = 0.10).
- Baseline ρ = +0.139 (p ≈ 0.70): the association collapses on the Baseline control map.
- Negative sign: gates with stronger WildR>SPF NEUROeSTIMator effects carry lower mean positive Intruder t under gate allocation.
:::
:::

```{r}
#| label: display-gate-triad-table
#| echo: false

if (!is.null(gate_triad)) {
  knitr::kable(
    gate_triad[
      order(neuro_hedges_g),
      .(
        final_gate,
        neuro_hedges_g,
        intruder_positive_mean_t,
        baseline_positive_mean_t,
        wildr_ib_positive_mean_t,
        spf_ib_positive_mean_t
      )
    ],
    digits = 3,
    caption = "Control triad of gate-allocated positive mean t scores."
  )
}
```

### H4 — Within-genotype Intruder−Baseline partially overlaps the Intruder signal

::: {.takeaways}
**Decision: `r decision_of("H4")`**

- \|ρ\|_Intruder = 0.661 versus \|ρ\|_SPF I−B = 0.636 and \|ρ\|_WildR I−B = 0.115.
- Intruder edges the stronger I−B map, but bootstrap P(Δ ≤ 0) ≈ 0.64, so the excess is not stable.
- Interpret H3 as Intruder-associated but not cleanly separable from SPF context-driven 2DG structure.
:::

### H5 — ROI seed footprints are not yet anatomically diagnostic

::: {.figure-card}
```{r}
#| label: display-h5
#| echo: false
#| out.width: "100%"

display_saved_image(
  roi_figure,
  "ROI seed overlap figure not yet written."
)
```

::: {.fig-caption}
[**Figure 5.**]{.fig-num} IoU of WildR Intruder ROI overlay footprints versus
expected Allen parcels on seed slices. Several seed planes fail continuity QC
and are excluded from the mean.
:::

::: {.takeaways}
**Decision: `r decision_of("H5")`**

- Only 3/6 seed slices are in `accepted_final`; mean IoU ≈ 0.004.
- L_LS / R_Cg footprints under current AP assignment do not land in septal/cingulate parcels.
- This is spatial QC failure for the ROI overlays as anatomical masks—not a claim about activity biology.
:::
:::

```{r}
#| label: display-battery-table
#| echo: false

if (!is.null(battery)) {
  knitr::kable(
    battery[
      ,
      .(
        hypothesis_id,

        estimate,
        p_perm,
        control_result
      )
    ],

    caption = "Full pre-specified hypothesis battery."
  )
}
```

### Findings

1. **H1 supported.** Strict Template→CCF registration yields 53 accepted slices at mean Dice 0.960 with an intact continuity gate.
2. **H2 not supported.** Limbic/hypothalamic \|t\| enrichment is a Baseline property, not an Intruder-specific one.
3. **H3 supported.** Gate-allocated Intruder positive mean t correlates with NEUROeSTIMator Hedges' g (ρ = −0.66, p ≈ 0.041); Baseline does not.
4. **H4 inconclusive.** SPF Intruder−Baseline nearly matches Intruder \|ρ\|, so genotype WildR−SPF Intruder is not cleanly isolated from context-driven structure.
5. **H5 inconclusive.** ROI seed overlays do not currently provide trustworthy anatomical parcel footprints under accepted CCF planes.

::: {.callout-warning}
None of these tests are animal-level. 2DG remains a group map; seqFISH still
lacks a verified section→animal key. Do not promote H3 to a confirmatory
genotype effect without that key and without resolving H4.
:::

## Next Steps

- Obtain a verified seqFISH section→animal key before any inferential cross-modality model.
- Resolve H4 with scalar (non-RGB) Intruder−Baseline exports if available.
- Revisit ROI overlays only after confirming they are anatomical masks rather than contrast displays.
- Optionally warp Behavior stacks under the same Template transforms as a separate map family.
